# Component skeleton template

The format of each generated component file. Consume the framework profile + UI library profile + the decomposition plan, then emit one file per component.

## File structure

```tsx
// Generated by knowject-read-design from <design source basename>.
// UI library: <ui_library>@<ui_library_version> (per knowject/context.yaml#stack.frontend.ui).
// Edit at will - re-running knowject-read-design will not overwrite this file unless you confirm.
import type { FC } from 'react';
<import-line from profile.import_template, expanded with the libraries' actual primitives>

interface <ComponentName>Props {
  <slot-name>: <inferred-or-unknown-type>;
  // ... one prop per slot from the decomposition plan
}

export const <ComponentName>: FC<<ComponentName>Props> = ({
  <slot-name>,
  ...
}) => (
  <root-element className="<tailwind-classes>">
    {/* layout matches the decomposition plan's slot order */}
  </root-element>
);
```

## Prop typing rules

- **Strings:** typed as `string`. Use `string` not `String`.
- **Numbers, counts:** `number`.
- **Lists:** `string[]` if items are plain strings; otherwise declare a sibling `interface` and reference it.
- **Children:** if the slot accepts arbitrary nodes, type as `ReactNode` and import from `react`.
- **Click handlers, callbacks:** `() => void` for no-arg, `(value: T) => void` for parametric.
- **Unknown:** when the slot's type is genuinely ambiguous, use `unknown` (not `any`) and leave a one-line `// TODO(knowject-read-design): type this` comment.

## File naming

`<components_dir>/<ComponentName>/index.<component_extension>` is the canonical path. Page-level wrappers go to `<pages_dir>/<page-kebab>/index.<component_extension>` and import from the components directory.

## Imports

- `import type { FC } from 'react'` - always; gives the function the right typing without runtime cost.
- Library imports follow `profile.import_template`. For shadcn, expand the placeholder to the actual kebab-cased path: `<Component>` = `Card` -> `@/components/ui/card`.
- No unused imports. If you import `Avatar` and don't render one, remove the import before writing.

## What NOT to include

- **Real data.** Empty arrays, empty strings, zero counts - let the page-level wrapper or the route data provide the real values.
- **State.** Skeletons are stateless. Use `useState` only if the decomposition plan explicitly says the component is interactive.
- **Tests.** Out of scope for read-design; the user runs the project's own test workflow.
- **Storybook stories.** Same - out of scope.

## Reference

See [`examples/sample-skeleton.tsx`](./examples/sample-skeleton.tsx) for a working antd-flavored skeleton.
